description: Synthetic demonstration images for FE-001 (no real extinguisher photos yet). Replace with real photos taken without handling the extinguisher, then re-run tools/precompute_demo_assessments.py --force.

items.caption: Gauge dial (synthetic graphic from the model)
items.source: Synthetic test image generated from the FE-001 illustrative model on 2026-10-24. Not a photograph of a real extinguisher.

result.summary: Image is a synthetic illustrative gauge graphic labeled DEMO, not a photograph of a real extinguisher gauge. The dial face and needle are clearly visible; the needle points within the green band.
observations: Circular gauge face with grey bezel, shown straight on with no glare.
Colored arc: red left, green center, red right; no numeric values or text labels on the arc.
Black needle clearly visible, pointing into the green band.
Text 'DEMO' and 'illustrative' printed on the face.
No visible cracks or damage on the depicted lens or bezel.
No extinguisher body, valve or other context visible.
conditions_for_human_review: Image appears to be a synthetic graphic, not field evidence from asset FE-001-DEMO.
missing_information: Real photograph of the gauge on the actual extinguisher
Context showing the gauge mounted on the valve of FE-001-DEMO
Legible manufacturer markings or zone labels on the dial
result.retake_guidance: Photograph the actual gauge on extinguisher FE-001-DEMO: close-up, straight on, no glare, whole dial and printed markings in focus, with part of the valve visible for context.
limitations: Synthetic demo graphic cannot serve as evidence for a physical asset.
Needle in the green band does not establish charge, pressure or readiness.
Dial ranges are manufacturer-dependent and not legible here.
Internal condition and pressure cannot be verified from a photo.

items.caption: Valve head with the safety pin and seal removed (synthetic: simulates a missing pin)
items.source: Synthetic test image generated from the FE-001 illustrative model on 2026-10-24. Not a photograph of a real extinguisher.

result.summary: Valve head is visible, but no safety pin, pull ring or tamper seal can be seen. A possible missing pin and seal needs human review.
observations: Valve head, carry handle, lever, gauge and hose are visible.
No safety pin or pull ring is visible through the valve head.
A thin wire/cord and a blank grey tag hang from the valve head; no text is legible on the tag.
The image is a synthetic rendering, not a real product photo.
conditions_for_human_review: Safety pin appears missing from the valve head.
A loose wire/cord is near the tag; it may be a remnant of a seal and needs a check.
missing_information: Pin and seal may be on the side of the valve head not shown; the opposite side is not visible.
limitations: Only one side of the valve head is shown.
A photo cannot confirm pressure, charge or readiness.
The gauge needle is not legible and was not assessed.

items.caption: Full extinguisher (synthetic render of the model)
items.source: Synthetic test image generated from the FE-001 illustrative model on 2026-10-24. Not a photograph of a real extinguisher.

result.summary: Synthetic render shows the whole extinguisher from base boot to valve, front side only. No obvious corrosion, dents or damage visible at this small scale. Usable as evidence; inspector decides.
observations: Full extinguisher visible: base boot, red cylinder, label area, hose, valve, handle, pin and tag.
Cylinder surface appears uniform red with no visible corrosion, dents or exposed metal.
Hose, handle, safety pin and tag appear present.
Extinguisher occupies a small part of the frame; fine surface detail is limited.
Bright white background flagged as overexposed by heuristics; cylinder itself is reasonably exposed.
Image is a synthetic render, not a real photograph.
Only one side of the cylinder is shown; rear and base underside are not visible.
missing_information: Rear side of cylinder not shown.
Close-up detail of cylinder surface and base boot.
limitations: Internal cylinder condition cannot be determined from a photograph.
Pressure, charge and serviceability cannot be verified from a photo.
Small subject size may hide minor dents or corrosion.
Demo render; does not represent a real asset condition.
